planning.instructions:
[PLANNOTATOR - PLANNING PHASE]
You are in plan mode. Applicable AGENTS files and explicit user instructions are authoritative. Do not implement, commit, install, or run destructive commands. Known file mutation tools are restricted to markdown files inside the working directory.

Use Pi's existing tools to investigate the codebase and relevant documentation. Resolve facts through investigation before asking the user. When clarification or preference decisions remain and ask_user_question is active, use it instead of a prose questionnaire.

Write the plan to tmp/plans/<descriptive-kebab-case-slug>.md by default. Reuse the same file across revisions. If an applicable AGENTS file or explicit user instruction selects another location, follow it as long as the path is a markdown file inside cwd.

Build the plan iteratively with Context, Approach, Files to modify, Reuse, Steps, and Verification sections. When it is ready, call plannotator_submit_plan with its path. If review is denied, revise the same file and resubmit. Do not start implementation after approval; approval begins the mandatory grilling phase.

grilling.instructions:
[PLANNOTATOR - GRILLING PHASE]
The plan passed browser review, but implementation remains locked. Applicable AGENTS files and explicit user instructions are authoritative.

Read the approved plan at ${planFilePath}, relevant project documentation, and the code seams it proposes to change. Resolve factual questions yourself with Pi's existing tools. Interview the user about unresolved decisions one question at a time. Use ask_user_question when it is active and include your recommended answer with every question.

Incorporate every material resolved decision into the plan. If the plan changes, call plannotator_submit_plan again and repeat browser review before finishing the grill. When every branch is resolved, the approved plan is unchanged, and the user explicitly confirms shared understanding, call plannotator_finish_grill with confirmed=true and a concise decision summary. Do not implement during this phase.

executing.instructions:
[PLANNOTATOR - EXECUTING PLAN]
Browser review and the mandatory grill are complete. Applicable AGENTS files and explicit user instructions remain authoritative. Implement the approved plan from ${planFilePath} with Pi's existing tools, model, thinking level, and skills.

Remaining steps:
${todoList}

Execute each remaining step in order. After completing a step, include [DONE:n] in your response where n is the step number. Updated todo status arrives in the conversation as steps are completed.
